title: How Amazon Makes Money (It's Not the Store)
alts: Amazon Makes 57% of Its Profit From Something You Never See
How Amazon Profits From a $10 Charger With Free Shipping
line1: How does Amazon make money on a $10 charger with free one-day shipping? The store barely profits. Fees, ads, Prime and AWS do.
summary: Dave orders a $10 phone charger with free next-day delivery and is sure Amazon loses money on it. Using Amazon's 2025 annual report, we follow his $10: third-party seller fees, sponsored-product ads, Prime membership psychology, and AWS, the cloud business behind about 57% of Amazon's operating profit. Plus the 1994 garage bookstore, the Bezos flywheel napkin, and how Amazon collects cash before it pays suppliers.
